annotations.title: Look up a part's datasheet figures

description: Look up an RF component in the validated catalog by manufacturer part number: the catalog's summary of its headline figures, not the full datasheet. Returns the frequency, power and gain ranges, package, datasheet link, and the headline figures (Psat, P1dB, gain, noise figure, OIP3, insertion and conversion loss, junction-to-case thermal resistance, maximum junction temperature), each with its datasheet page where one is on file. Figures the record lacks are listed as not in the record, and internal estimates are named but never given as numbers. It does NOT hold derating, absolute-maximum ratings, bias, test conditions or footnotes: for those, read the datasheet link. Use this whenever the user names a specific part, so answers come from catalog data rather than recall.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number to look up (e.g. 'TGA2624-SM', 'ADL5904', 'MAX2871'). Match is exact; the user's shortened form may need the family suffix.

user_request.description: The end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. Used to verify that the figures you pass were stated by your user rather than inferred. Omit it and the results will be labelled caller-asserted.
